levels.surface: عبد الله بن عامر بن زرارة

notes: The man who comes to the judges is only in the scene; Abu Musa and Salman answer (dual فقالا) and Ibn Mas'ud answers the man, each answerer a link in turn (rule 6).
The verdict the report relays as its saying is Ibn Mas'ud's, so he is last; reading of the two earlier answerers is the least certain part.
